title: PENGARUH MORDAN TAWAS, KAPUR SIRIH DAN TUNJUNG TERHADAP PENCELUPAN EKSTRAK DAUN MANGGA DAN ECOPRINT DAUN PEPAYA JEPANG (Cnidoscolus aconitifolius) PADA BAHAN SATIN VELVET MENGGUNAKAN TEKNIK POUNDING
abstract: This study aimed to describe the color hue, motif clarity, and washing fastness of satin velvet dyed with mango-leaf extract and decorated with Japanese papaya leaves (Cnidoscolus aconitifolius) using the pounding ecoprint technique under different mordants. The study employed an experimental approach. The treatments consisted of alum, betel lime, and ferrous sulfate (tunjung), with an unmordanted treatment used as a comparison. Fifteen panelists, consisting of three limited panelists and twelve trained panelists, evaluated motif clarity and washing fastness. Hue was identified digitally using a Color Picker application based on RGB and HEX values. Data were analyzed descriptively for hue and by the Friedman test for ordinal scores. The results showed different hue characteristics for each treatment. Alum produced Lemon Chiffon on the fabric ground and Misty Moss on the leaf tissue, betel lime produced Sunset on the ground and Spanish Bistre on the leaf tissue, while tunjung produced Battleship Gray on the ground and Rifle Green on the leaf tissue. title: ANALISIS KESALAHAN PENGGUNAAN BAHASA SESUAI EYD PADA KOMENTAR DALAM POSTINGAN MENGENAI ISU MBG DI INSTAGRAM
abstract: Social media has become a space for written communication in which users frequently employ informal language that does not always conform to standard Indonesian spelling conventions. This study aims to identify and describe spelling errors in Instagram comments on posts discussing the Free Nutritious Meals (MBG) program based on the fifth edition of the Enhanced Indonesian Spelling System (EYD V). This study employed a descriptive qualitative method using 20 Instagram comments collected from posts published between September 11 and 23, 2026. Data was collected through non-participant observation and note-taking techniques, then analyzed according to the spelling rules established in EYD V. The findings revealed various spelling inconsistencies, particularly in capitalization, word formation, preposition usage, abbreviations, numerals, and punctuation. Common examples included lowercase letters in official abbreviations, numbers used to indicate repeated words, incorrect spacing in prefixes and prepositions, informal abbreviations, nonstandard spelling, and excessive punctuation. title: PENINGKATAN LITERASI MATEMATIKA DAN KEMAMPUAN BERPIKIR KRITIS DENGAN PEMBELAJARAN TEAMS GAME TOURNAMENTS (TGT) BERBANTUAN MEDIA MATH RIDDLE MISSION DAN TTS INTERAKTIF UNTUK SISWA KELAS 5 SDN KAUMAN LOR 03 KABUPATEN SEMARANG
abstract: This study aimed to improve the mathematical literacy and critical thinking skills of fifth-grade students at SDN Kauman Lor 03, Semarang Regency, through the implementation of the Teams Game Tournaments (TGT) learning model assisted by Math Riddle Mission media and interactive crossword puzzles. This study was motivated by students’ low ability to understand mathematical word problems, relate problem contexts to arithmetic operations, and apply critical thinking skills in solving mathematical problems. The research employed Classroom Action Research (CAR) using the Kemmis and McTaggart model, conducted in two cycles. Each cycle consisted of planning, action implementation, observation, and reflection stages. The subjects of this study were 9 fifth-grade students of SDN Kauman Lor 03. Data collection techniques included tests, observations and documentation. The results showed that the implementation of the TGT model, assisted by Math Riddle Mission media and interactive crossword puzzles was able to improve students’ mathematical literacy and critical thinking skills. title: PEMANFAATAN MEDIA ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE UNTUK MENINGKATKAN KEMAMPUAN AKADEMIK MAHASISWA PROGRAM STUDI MAGISTER PENDIDIKAN AGAMA ISLAM UNIVERSITAS KH. ABDUL CHALIM MOJOKERTO
abstract: This study analyzes the utilization of Artificial Intelligence (AI) media and its implications for students’ academic abilities in the Master’s Program of Islamic Religious Education at Universitas KH. Abdul Chalim Mojokerto. The study employed a qualitative case study approach. Data were collected through observation, interviews with the head of the study program, lecturers, and students, and documentation. Data analysis involved data reduction, presentation, and conclusion drawing, while credibility was strengthened through triangulation of sources and techniques. The findings show that students use AI mainly to understand complex learning materials, organize outlines and academic writing, conduct preliminary exploration and reference searches, and develop teaching materials and instructional media. AI functions as an academic facilitator that helps students work more systematically, purposefully, and efficiently. The implications are twofold. Positively, AI facilitates comprehension of complex Islamic Religious Education topics, access to preliminary information and references, academic creativity, writing organization, and digital literacy. title: UPAYA MENINGKATKAN KERJASAMA DALAM PEMBELAJARAN PJOK DENGAN PENDEKATAN PERMAINAN GOBOY SISWA KELAS VI SDN BETET 3 KOTA KEDIRI
abstract: This study aims to improve the cooperation skills of sixth-grade students at SDN Betet 3 in Physical Education, Sports, and Health learning through the implementation of the Goboy game. This study used a Classroom Action Research (CAR) method conducted in two cycles, with each cycle consisting of planning, action implementation, observation, and reflection stages. The subjects of the study were 26 sixth-grade students of SDN Betet 3. Data were collected through observations of students' cooperation skills and documentation, then analyzed descriptively and quantitatively using total scores, averages, and percentages. The results showed an improvement in students' cooperation skills, from the initial condition with a total score of 1,253, an average of 48.19, and a percentage of 60.24%, to a total score of 1,500, an average of 57.69, and a percentage of 72.12% in Cycle I. In Cycle II, the results increased to a total score of 1,780, an average of 68.46, and a percentage of 85.58%. The number of students achieving the minimum score of 60 increased from 0 students (0%) in the initial condition to 10 students (38.46%) in Cycle I and 25 students (96.15%) in Cycle II. title: EFEKTIVITAS PROGRAM MULTIMEDIA INTERAKTIF DALAM MENDUKUNG PEMAHAMAN KONSEPTUAL DAN RETENSI BELAJAR MAHASISWA PADA MATA KULIAH WORKSHOP MATEMATIKA DI UNIVERSITAS TERBUKA
abstract: Learning retention is an important indicator of learning success, particularly in open and distance higher education, where students are required to manage much of their learning independently. This study aimed to analyze changes in students’ conceptual understanding after learning with an Interactive Multimedia Program (IMP) and to describe the sustainability of learning outcomes one week after instruction in the Mathematics Workshop course at Universitas Terbuka. A quantitative pre-experimental approach with a one-group pretest-posttest-retention test design was employed. Participants were 38 undergraduate Mathematics Education students from Universitas Terbuka regional offices in Jakarta, Yogyakarta, and Malang. Data were collected using the same 25-item multiple-choice test at the pretest, posttest, and retention-test stages and analyzed using descriptive statistics, normalized gain, a normality test, and paired-sample t-tests. title: PENGARUH PEMBERIAN MASSAGE OLAHRAGA TERHADAP TINGKAT NYERI OTOT TUNGKAI PADA PEMAIN SEPAK BOLA KLUB MUSPIKA UNIMED FC
abstract: Leg muscle pain is a common complaint among soccer players resulting from intense physical activities such as running, kicking, jumping, and sudden changes of direction which can trigger Delayed Onset Muscle Soreness (DOMS) and potentially impair performance and readiness for subsequent training sessions if not managed properly. Players from Muspika Unimed FC frequently experience leg muscle pain following high-intensity training sessions or matches; however, the recovery management provided including the systematic use of sports massage has not yet been optimal or structured. This study aimed to determine the effect of sports massage on leg muscle pain levels among Muspika Unimed FC soccer players. A quasi-experimental study with a one-group pretest-posttest design was conducted involving 11 players selected via total sampling. Pain levels were measured using the Visual Analogue Scale (VAS) before and after a 15–20 minute sports massage session, and the data were analyzed using the Wilcoxon signed-rank test and the paired-sample t-test. title: PENINGKATAN KEMAMPUAN MANAJEMEN WAKTU MELALUI LAYANAN BIMBINGAN KLASIKAL BERBASIS PROBLEM BASED LEARNING PADA SISWA KELAS VII-B SMPN NEGERI 11 MADIUN TAHUN PELAJARAN 2025/2026
abstract: Time management is an important skill that helps students balance learning and leisure activities. The results of the Student Needs Assessment at SMP Negeri 11 Madiun indicated that some students still experienced difficulties in managing their time effectively. This study aimed to improve students' time management skills through classical guidance services based on Problem Based Learning (PBL). This study employed a One Group Pretest-Posttest Design within the framework of Guidance and Counseling Action Research involving 24 seventh-grade students of SMP Negeri 11 Madiun. Data were collected using a time management questionnaire and analyzed using normality tests, Paired Sample T-Test, and N-Gain. The results showed that the data were normally distributed, with significance values of 0.503 for the pre-test and 0.076 for the post-test. title: PENERAPAN METODE THINK PAIR SHARE UNTUK MENINGKATKAN KEAKTIFAN SISWA KELAS VII DI SMPN 4 MADIUN MELALUI LAYANAN BIMBINGAN KLASIKAL
abstract: Student activeness is an important factor in the success of classical guidance services. However, preliminary observations at SMP Negeri 4 Madiun indicated that seventh-grade students demonstrated low levels of participation, as reflected in their reluctance to ask questions, express opinions, and engage in discussions during guidance sessions. This study aimed to improve student activeness through the implementation of the Think Pair Share (TPS) method in classical guidance services. The research employed a Guidance and Counseling Action Research (PTBK) approach based on the Kemmis and McTaggart model, consisting of planning, action, observation, and reflection conducted in two cycles. The participants were seventh-grade students of SMP Negeri 4 Madiun. Data were collected through observation and documentation using an observation sheet covering five indicators of student activeness: independent thinking, paired discussion, confidence in expressing opinions, willingness to ask and answer questions, and attention and participation during the guidance sessions. Data were analyzed descriptively using percentage analysis supported by qualitative descriptive interpretation. The finding

title: PENGUATAN PENDIDIKAN AGAMA ISLAM MELALUI PENDAMPINGAN KEAGAMAAN DAN PEMBINAAN KARAKTER ANAK DI DESA KARANG TENGAH KECAMATAN SERBA JADI KABUPATEN SERDANG BEDAGAI
abstract: This study aims to describe the forms of religious mentoring, the implementation of children's character development, and the supporting factors, inhibiting factors, and impacts on strengthening Islamic Religious Education (PAI) in Karang Tengah Village, Serba Jadi Subdistrict, Serdang Bedagai Regency. This study employed a qualitative approach with a case study design. Data were collected through participatory observation, in-depth interviews, and documentation studies involving the village head and village officials, religious leaders, parents, and children participating in the mentoring activities, who were selected using purposive sampling. The data were analyzed using the interactive model of Miles and Huberman (1994), consisting of data reduction, data display, and conclusion drawing, with data credibility maintained through source and method triangulation. The findings show that religious mentoring is carried out through Qur'anic learning centers (TPQ), guidance in religious practices, and children's recitation and yasin gatherings, which collectively reinforce the implementation of PAI outside the formal education pathway. title: PENERAPAN COGNITIVE REAPPRAISAL MELALUI LAYANAN BIMBINGAN KLASIKAL UNTUK MENINGKATKAN REGULASI EMOSI SISWA KELAS VII SMP NEGERI 11 MADIUN
abstract: This study aims to improve the emotion regulation of seventh-grade students (class VII E) at SMP Negeri 11 Madiun through the implementation of the cognitive reappraisal technique in classical guidance services, as well as to describe the implementation process of the actions in each cycle. The research was grounded in the results of the Student Needs Assessment (AKPD), which showed that 64.5% of students had not been able to manage their emotions well, a finding confirmed by a standardized pre-cycle measurement in which 67.7% of students were in the Low category. The study used the Guidance and Counseling Action Research (PTBK) method based on the model of Kemmis, McTaggart, and Nixon (2014), carried out in two cycles involving 31 students. Data were collected using an emotion regulation questionnaire (31 valid items, α = 0.900) adapted from the Emotion Regulation Questionnaire by Gross and John (2003), and analyzed both quantitatively (mean scores, category percentages, Wilcoxon Signed-Rank Test, Cohen's d) and qualitatively (observation and reflection on the actions). title: PENERAPAN PERMAINAN INVASI MODIFIKASI PASSING BOLA BASKET UNTUK MENINGKATKAN KEAKTIFAN DAN KETERAMPILAN PASSING SISWA KELAS VI SDN JAGALAN 01 KOTA KEDIRI
abstract: This classroom action research aimed to improve students’ activity and basketball passing skills through the implementation of a modified invasion game. The study involved 30 sixth-grade students of SDN Jagalan 01 Kota Kediri and was conducted in two cycles using the Kemmis and McTaggart model, consisting of planning, action, observation, and reflection. Data were collected through student activity observation, performance assessment of passing skills, and documentation. Student activity was assessed based on six aspects: attention, participation, enthusiasm, involvement in the game, cooperation, and willingness to try. Passing skills were assessed based on six aspects: hand position, execution of the passing movement, passing direction accuracy, control of passing force, target accuracy, and the ability to apply passing skills in game situations. The results showed consistent improvement. The mean passing skill score increased from 68.13 in the pre-cycle to 75.42 in Cycle I and 82.71 in Cycle II. title: Penerapan Permainan Tantangan Gerak Bertingkat untuk Meningkatkan Motivasi Belajar PJOK Siswa Kelas III Sekolah Dasar
abstract: Penelitian tindakan kelas ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan motivasi belajar siswa kelas tiga sekolah dasar melalui implementasi permainan Tantangan Gerakan Bertingkat dalam Pendidikan Jasmani, Olahraga, dan Kesehatan. Penelitian ini dilakukan dalam dua siklus, dengan setiap siklus terdiri dari perencanaan, tindakan, observasi, dan refleksi. Partisipan penelitian adalah 25 siswa kelas tiga. Motivasi belajar diamati melalui sepuluh indikator menggunakan skala penilaian empat poin. Data dianalisis secara deskriptif menggunakan nilai rata-rata, persentase, rentang nilai, perubahan indikator, dan jumlah siswa yang mencapai kriteria keberhasilan yang telah ditentukan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa nilai rata-rata motivasi meningkat dari 12,28 atau 30,70% pada kondisi awal menjadi 18,92 atau 47,30% pada Siklus I dan kemudian menjadi 33,52 atau 83,80% pada Siklus II. Jumlah siswa yang mencapai kriteria 76% meningkat dari nol pada kondisi awal dan Siklus I menjadi seluruh 25 siswa atau 100% pada Siklus II. Semua indikator motivasi membaik, dengan peningkatan yang signifikan dalam hal kenikmatan, kerja sama, konsentrasi, dan kemauan untuk mencoba lagi. Temuan ini menunjukkan bahwa perma

title: UPAYA MENINGKATKAN KETERAMPILAN FREE THROW BOLA BASKET MELALUI MODIFIKASI BOLA DAN RING PADA SISWA KELAS V SDN BANJARAN 2 KOTA KEDIRI
abstract: This classroom action research aimed to improve free throw basketball skills through ball and ring modification among fifth-grade students at SDN Banjaran 2 Kediri City. The study involved 29 students and was conducted through a pre-cycle on 20 August 2026, Cycle I on 27 August 2026, and Cycle II on 3 September 2026. The intervention replaced a size-6 basketball with a size-5 plastic/foam ball and lowered the ring height from 3.05 m to 2.60 m. The intervention was combined with demonstration, gradual practice, repetition, specific feedback, and reflection. Data were collected through performance assessment and observation. Quantitative data were analyzed descriptively using mean scores and classical mastery percentages. In this working journal draft, simulated scores are used to demonstrate the analysis format and must be verified against authentic field records before academic submission. The simulated mean score increased from 64.66 in the pre-cycle to 72.93 in Cycle I and 83.28 in Cycle II, while classical mastery increased from 10.34% to 58.62% and 93.10%.

title: PENERAPAN PERMAINAN HITAM-HIJAU UNTUK MENINGKATKAN FOKUS BELAJAR SISWA DALAM PEMBELAJARAN PJOK KELAS II DI SDN BANJARAN 2 KOTA KEDIRI
abstract: This classroom action research was conducted based on the problem of students’ lack of focus during Physical Education, Sports, and Health (PJOK) learning in Grade II at SDN Banjaran 2 Kota Kediri. The study aimed to improve students’ learning focus through the implementation of the Hitam-Hijau game. The research was conducted using a classroom action research design consisting of a pre-cycle stage and two cycles, with 28 Grade II students as the research subjects. Data were collected through observation using five indicators of learning focus: paying attention to teacher instructions, paying attention to explanations and demonstrations, maintaining attention during the game, waiting for the signal before moving, and responding according to the signal. Data were analyzed descriptively by calculating individual scores, class averages, and percentages of the maximum score. The results showed an increase in students’ learning focus from the pre-cycle to the second cycle. The average score increased from 11.93 (59.64%) in the pre-cycle to 14.21 (71.07%) in Cycle I and 16.14 (80.71%) in Cycle II. The results of Cycle II exceeded the success criterion of 75%. title: UPAYA PENINGKATAN HASIL BELAJAR SERVIS BAWAH BOLA VOLI MELALUI MODIFIKASI BOLA SPONS PADA PESERTA DIDIK KELAS V SDN BANJARAN 2 KOTA KEDIRI
abstract: This classroom action research aimed to improve the learning outcomes of underhand volleyball serving through the use of a sponge ball modification among fifth-grade students at SDN Banjaran 2 Kota Kediri. The participants were 29 students. The research was conducted through a pre-cycle, Cycle I, and Cycle II, with the stages of planning, action, observation, and reflection. Data were collected through performance tests, observations, and documentation. The performance assessment covered initial stance and body/foot position, ball grip or position, arm swing, ball contact, follow-through and weight transfer, and serve direction. The results showed that the mean score increased from 59.17 in the pre-cycle to 69.66 in Cycle I and 78.83 in Cycle II. Classical mastery increased from 0% to 17.24% and 86.21%, respectively. In Cycle II, 25 of 29 students achieved the minimum score of 75, so classical mastery exceeded the 80% success criterion. title: EDUKASI MENABUNG BERBASIS PRINSIP SYARIAH SEBAGAI UPAYA MENANAMKAN LITERASI KEUANGAN, KEMANDIRIAN, DAN KARAKTER ISLAMI PADA ANAK SEJAK DINI DI DESA KARANG TENGAH KECAMATAN SERBA JADI KABUPATEN SERDANG BEDAGAI
abstract: This study aims to describe and analyze the implementation of Sharia-based saving education as an effort to instill financial literacy, independence, and Islamic character in children from an early age in Karang Tengah Village, Serba Jadi Subdistrict, Serdang Bedagai Regency. The background of this research is grounded in the low level of understanding among children in rural areas regarding financial management that aligns with Islamic values, as well as the limited habituation of saving from an early age, which subsequently weakens children's financial independence and Islamic character formation. This research employed a qualitative approach with a descriptive field research design. Data were collected through participatory observation, in-depth interviews with parents, community leaders, religious teachers, and children, as well as documentation of Sharia-based saving education activities conducted at the research site. Data were analyzed using the interactive model of Miles and Huberman, comprising data reduction, data display, and conclusion drawing, with data validity tested through source and method triangulation. title: KONSEP DEEP LEARNING DALAM PERSPEKTIF MENURUT ZAKIAH DARADJAT
abstract: This study examines the concept of deep learning in modern education through the perspective of Zakiah Daradjat's thought. The background of this research is grounded in the gap between the ideal aspirations of national education and empirical realities, namely the low cognitive abilities of students based on PISA 2022 data, the crisis of character, and the dominance of surface learning practices in classrooms. Employing a qualitative approach with library research and content analysis techniques, this study examines and synthesizes the three main pillars of deep learning—namely Mindful Learning, Meaningful Learning, and Joyful Learning—within the framework of Islamic educational thought according to Zakiah Daradjat. The results of the analysis indicate that these three pillars share a strong intersection with Daradjat's ideas: Mindful Learning integrates with the concept of religious consciousness, Meaningful Learning meets the internalization of values and morals, and Joyful Learning aligns with the creation of inner peace and a learning atmosphere free from destructive pressure. title: PENDEKATAN DEEP LEARNING BERBASIS PROBLEM BASED LEARNING UNTUK MENINGKATKAN COMPUTATIONAL THINKING SISWA
abstract: Kemampuan Computational Thinking (CT) peserta didik pada materi struktur data (list, tuple, set) belum berkembang optimal, khususnya pada proses abstraksi dan algoritma, karena pembelajaran masih berpusat pada penjelasan konsep dan media presentasi statis yang kurang memfasilitasi latihan bertahap serta studi kasus kontekstual. Penelitian ini bertujuan merancang media StrucLearn berbasis Problem Based Learning (PBL) yang diintegrasikan dengan prinsip meaningful dari pendekatan Deep Learning pada materi struktur data, mengetahui peningkatan kemampuan Computational Thinking peserta didik, serta mengetahui tanggapan mereka terhadap media tersebut. Metode yang digunakan adalah model ADDIE (Analyze, Design, Development, Implementation, Evaluation) dan desain one-group pretest-posttest, melibatkan 31 peserta didik kelas X SIJA B SMK Negeri 1 Cimahi yang dipilih melalui convenience sampling. Hasil validasi ahli menyatakan media layak digunakan dengan kategori baik setelah dilakukan perbaikan. title: MANAJEMEN KURIKULUM MERDEKA DALAM PEMBELAJARAN DIFERENSIASI DI MADRASAH ALIYAH NEGERI LUWU
abstract: This study was motivated by the importance of managing the Merdeka Curriculum in supporting differentiated learning oriented toward students' needs, interests, and individual characteristics. It aimed to describe the management of the Merdeka Curriculum in differentiated learning and to identify the supporting and inhibiting factors of its implementation at Madrasah Aliyah Negeri (MAN) Luwu. This research employed a qualitative approach with a descriptive type. Data were obtained through observation, interviews, and documentation involving the head of madrasah, the vice head for curriculum affairs, and teachers. Data were analyzed through data reduction, data display, and conclusion drawing, while data validity was examined using source and method triangulation. The results show that the management of the Merdeka Curriculum has been carried out through the stages of planning, implementation, and evaluation. Planning was conducted by developing the Madrasah Operational Curriculum, learning outcomes, learning objective flows, and teaching modules tailored to students' needs. title: STRATEGI KOMUNIKASI KANTOR IMIGRASI KELAS I NON TPI BEKASI DALAM MENINGKATKAN PEMAHAMAN MASYARAKAT TERHADAP LAYANAN PASPOR DI MALL PELAYANAN PUBLIK KOTA BEKASI
abstract: This research aims to understand the communication strategy of the Class I Non TPI Bekasi Immigration Office in disseminating information regarding passport application services at the Bekasi City Public Service Mall (MPP) and to determine the level of public understanding of this service. This research uses a qualitative descriptive approach. Data was obtained through observation, in-depth interviews and documentation with informants selected using purposive sampling techniques. Data analysis was carried out through stages of data reduction, data presentation, as well as drawing conclusions and verification, with the validity of the data tested through triangulation of sources and methods. The research results show that the communication strategy has been quite effective through the use of social media, websites and direct outreach. Based on Middleton's Communication Strategy Theory, the elements of communicator, message, channel, recipient and effect have been implemented, although the use of conventional media at service locations is still not optimal. title: ANALISIS KESULITAN SISWA KELAS VIII DALAM MEMAHAMI TEKS QIRA’AH BERBAHASA ARAB DI MTSN 2 KOTA SURABAYA
abstract: This study was conducted based on the problem of low Arabic qira'ah text comprehension among eighth-grade students at MTsN 2 Surabaya. Many students experienced difficulties in understanding vocabulary, sentence structures, and the overall meaning of reading texts. The study aimed to identify the forms of difficulties encountered by students and the factors contributing to their low comprehension of qira'ah texts. This research employed a descriptive qualitative approach, with data collected through observation, interviews, and documentation. The participants consisted of an Arabic language teacher and several eighth-grade students. The findings revealed that the main obstacles faced by students were limited vocabulary mastery, inadequate understanding of Arabic grammatical structures, and difficulties in comprehending the overall content of the texts. Factors influencing these difficulties included limited basic Arabic language proficiency, low learning motivation, an unconducive classroom environment, and the use of reading materials perceived as too difficult by students. title: ANALISIS PENDEKATAN PEMBELAJARAN BAHASA ARAB DALAM MEMBANGUN INTERAKSI EDUKATIF DI MTSN 1 MOJOKERTO
abstract: Arabic proficiency helps madrasah students understand the sources of Islamic teaching and take part in Islamic scholarly discourse, but achieving it depends on learning approaches that build educational interaction in the classroom. This study analyzes the Arabic learning approaches teachers use to build such interaction in grade IX at MTsN 1 Mojokerto, along with the supporting and inhibiting factors involved. Data were collected through a qualitative case study design, using passive-participation observation, guided interviews with teachers and students, and documentation; these were analyzed with the Miles and Huberman interactive model and validated through source and technique triangulation. Teachers applied three approaches flexibly behaviorism, cognitivism, and constructivism each shaping a different interaction pattern: one-way stimulus-response, dialogic question-and-answer, and multi-directional group discussion. Adaptive teaching, active learning, a conducive classroom atmosphere, and student readiness supported this interaction, while gaps in students' prior abilities held it back. title: ANALYSIS OF TEACHER’S TECHNOLOGICAL PEDAGOGICAL AND CONTENT KNOWLEDGE (TPACK) ABILITIES AT KOTO XI TARUSAN PESISIR SELATAN HIGH SCHOOL
abstract: This study is motivated by the importance of teachers’ professionalism in Technological Pedagogical and Content Knowledge (TPACK) as an innovative instructional framework in 21st-century education. The study specifically examines the TPACK competence of Senior High School teachers in Koto XI Tarusan District, South Pesisir Regency. TPACK serves as the foundation for effective technology-enhanced teaching, which requires teachers’ understanding of representing subject matter concepts through appropriate technological tools and pedagogical approaches (Suyamto et al., 2020). This study employed a quantitative descriptive design. The population consisted of 140 teachers, with a sample of 60 teachers selected using Proportional Simple Random Sampling based on the Slovin formula. Data were collected using a 33-item questionnaire with a 5-point Likert scale. Validity and reliability were tested using SPSS version 25. The results indicate that Pedagogical Knowledge (PK) was high with a mean of 4.09 and an achievement rate of 81.9%. Content Knowledge (CK) was also high with a mean of 4.24 and 84.86%. title: KORELASI ANTARA INTENSITAS PENGGUNAAN MEDIA SOSIAL DENGAN TINGKAT BODY IMAGE DISSATISFACTION PADA MAHASISWI FISH UNJ ANGKATAN 2023–2025
abstract: This study aimed to examine the relationship between social media use intensity and body image dissatisfaction among female students of the Faculty of Social Sciences and Law, Universitas Negeri Jakarta, from the 2023–2025 cohorts. The study was motivated by the increasing use of social media, which has intensified exposure to appearance-related content and beauty standards that may influence individuals' perceptions of their own bodies. A quantitative approach with a correlational method and a cross-sectional design was employed. A total of 111 respondents were selected using a simple random sampling technique. Data were collected using two instruments: a Social Media Use Intensity Questionnaire developed based on the Uses and Gratifications Theory and the Body Shape Questionnaire (BSQ-8). The social media use intensity instrument was tested prior to data collection, resulting in 10 valid items with excellent reliability (Cronbach's Alpha = 0.884). Data analysis was conducted using the Kolmogorov–Smirnov normality test, followed by the Pearson Product Moment correlation test. title: PENERAPAN MINI GAME INTERAKTIF BERBASIS IFP UNTUK MENGOPTIMALKAN KEAKTIFAN DAN HASIL BELAJAR IPAS KELAS 3 UPT SD NEGERI MONDOKAN
abstract: This study is motivated by the unoptimized activeness of third-grade students at UPT SD Negeri Mondokan in Science and Social Studies (IPAS) learning. Students already possess high activeness, but it has not been well-channeled into productive learning activities. This research seeks to enhance pupils’ classroom participation and raise their academic attainment by introducing interactive mini-games delivered via an Interactive Flat Panel (IFP) within IPAS lessons focusing on energy. The effectiveness of the intervention was determined using assessment tests administered at the conclusion of each cycle, rather than by assessing performance in the games. A classroom action research (CAR) design was employed across three cycles, with each cycle comprising four stages: planning, action, observation, and reflection. The participants consisted of 29 Year 3 pupils at UPT SD Negeri Mondokan during the 2025/2026 academic year. Research data were obtained from pupil participation observation forms and achievement tests. title: PENGEMBANGAN E-MODUL ASAM BASA BERBASIS GUIDED DISCOVERY LEARNING TERINTEGRASI PEMBELAJARAN MENDALAM UNTUK MELATIH KETERAMPILAN BERPIKIR KRITIS MURID FASE F SMA/MA
abstract: This study addresses the low level of critical thinking skills among students in chemistry-specifically regarding the topic of acids and bases, which is considered abstract and difficult to grasp due to its reliance on microscopic representations. Although most students claimed to understand the topic, interviews revealed that many had only a superficial understanding; meanwhile, teachers remained heavily reliant on printed materials, indicating suboptimal use of technology-based learning resources. The study aimed to develop a Guided Discovery Learning (GDL)-based e-module on acids and bases-integrated with deep learning principles-to foster critical thinking skills in Phase F high school students, as well as to determine the e-module's validity and practicality. This Research and Development (R&D) study employed the 4D model (Define, Design, Develop, and Disseminate), limiting the scope to the Develop stage. The research subjects comprised five chemistry lecturers acting as expert validators, three chemistry teachers, and 33 Grade XII students from SMA Negeri 1 Pancung Soal. title: ANALISIS KUALITAS TEKNIS DAN PERSEPSI USABILITAS SISTEM PENGELOLAAN ASET BERBASIS QR CODE DENGAN GOOGLE LIGHTHOUSE DAN SYSTEM USABILITY SCALE (SUS)
abstract: This study evaluates a QR Code-based Asset Management System used in the Computer Engineering Department of Politeknik Negeri Sriwijaya through two distinct evidence streams: page-level technical auditing and user-reported usability. Google Lighthouse was applied to 10 pages selected to represent different processing loads, interface components, and system activities. Each URL was audited three times in Desktop configuration, yielding 30 audit results. Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO were summarized by category, and the sample standard deviation of Performance was additionally calculated to characterize repeatability. User evaluation employed the System Usability Scale (SUS) with 20 participants representing five system roles. Ten Likert responses were transformed using the SUS scoring rule, after which individual scores were described using the mean, median, sample standard deviation, range, and acceptability distribution. Lighthouse produced category means of 94.40 for Performance, 87.20 for Accessibility, 100.00 for Best Practices, and 91.00 for SEO. title: Efektivitas Penggunaan Media Pembelajaran Quizizz dalam Kurikulum Berbasis Cinta untuk Meningkatkan Hasil Belajar Bahasa Arab Materi Ar-Riyāḍah pada Siswa Kelas VIII F MTsN 2 Kota Surabaya
abstract: This study aims to analyze the effectiveness of Quizizz in improving Arabic learning outcomes on the topic of Ar-Riyāḍah based on the Love-Based Curriculum (KBC) among eighth-grade students of Class VIII F at MTsN 2 Surabaya. This quantitative study employed an experimental method with a One-Group Pretest–Posttest Design involving 34 students. Data were collected through pretests, posttests, and documentation. Data analysis included validity, reliability, Shapiro–Wilk, Wilcoxon Signed-Rank, and N-Gain tests. The results showed that the instrument was valid and reliable, with a Cronbach’s Alpha of 0.666. title: PENGARUH BABY SPA TERHADAP KUALITAS TIDUR BAYI USIA 3–6 BULAN DI PMB BIDAN LIA NURMALA KOTA JAMBI TAHUN 2026
abstract: Sound sleep is crucial for infant growth, as this is when brain development peaks. WHO data from 2022 indicates that approximately 33% of infants experience sleep problems. Both the quality and quantity of an infant's sleep require monitoring. Inadequate sleep and poor sleep quality can lead to various physiological and psychological imbalances. Various measures can be taken to address infant sleep issues, one of which is "baby spa" therapy. This study aimed to determine the effect of baby spa on the sleep quality of infants aged 3–6 months. It was a pre-experimental study utilizing a one-group pretest-posttest design. The research was conducted at the Midwife Lia Nurmala Independent Midwifery Practice (PMB) in Jambi City in August 2026. The study population consisted of all infants aged 3–6 months at the practice between March and June 2026, totaling 109 infants. A sample of 17 infants was selected using purposive sampling. Data were collected via questionnaires and analyzed using univariate and bivariate methods. title: PENGARUH MORDAN TAWAS, TUNJUNG, DAN KAPUR SIRIH TERHADAP HASIL ECOPRINT DAUN INSULIN (Tithonia diversifolia) DENGAN TEKNIK POUNDING PADA KAIN SATIN MAXMARA
abstract: This study aims to describe the effect of alum, iron, and lime mordants on the ecoprint results of insulin leaf (Tithonia diversifolia) using natural dye and the pounding technique on maxmara satin fabric, examined in terms of hue, motif clarity, and colorfastness to washing. The method used was an experimental design, in which maxmara satin fabric was pre-mordanted and post-mordanted with alum, iron, and lime. Color data were obtained through a color picker application, while motif clarity and colorfastness data were obtained from a questionnaire completed by 18 panelists and analyzed using the Friedman K-related sample test with SPSS version 25. The results show that unmordanted fabric produced a brownish hue (Metallic Sunburst); alum mordant produced a bright light-green hue (Spring Green); iron mordant produced a dark grey hue (Spanish Gray); and lime mordant produced a yellowish-brown hue (Khaki). In terms of motif clarity, iron mordant produced the clearest motifs, with 94.4% of panelists rating them as very clear, while alum mordant tended to produce the least distinct motifs. title: OPTIMASI MODEL LIGHTGBM UNTUK PREDIKSI DEMAM BERDARAH DENGUE MENGGUNAKAN OPTUNA PADA RSUD SYEKH YUSUF GOWA
abstract: Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) remains a significant infectious disease threat in tropical countries, including Indonesia. Early identification of severe clinical conditions based on medical records is crucial to prevent life-threatening plasma leakage complications. This study aims to construct an optimal classification model for predicting DHF clinical risk levels (Low Risk without Warning Signs vs. High Risk with Warning Signs) using the Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM) optimized with the Optuna framework. The secondary dataset was collected from RSUD Syekh Yusuf Gowa, comprising 267 clean clinical records partitioned with stratified sampling (80% training and 20% testing). Optuna with Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) and 5-Fold Stratified Cross-Validation was deployed across 50 trials to tune LightGBM hyperparameters by maximizing the Macro F1-score. The experimental results demonstrated that Optuna optimization significantly elevated the model performance compared to the baseline LightGBM: Accuracy increased from 90.74% to 92.59%, Precision Macro from 84.24% to 86.67%, Recall Macro from 81.11% to 86.67%, and F1-Score Macro from 82.55% to 86.67%. title: MODEL PENGAJARAN HYBRID BERBASIS DEEP LEARNING: REKONSTRUKSI METODOLOGI PENDIDIKAN ISLAM DI ERA 5.0
abstract: The abstract is a crucial component of a scientific article, as it provides a concise yet The Society 5.0 era presents disruptive challenges that demand a transformation of Islamic Religious Education (IRE) methodologies to make them more adaptable to developments in digital technology. This study aims to analyze the reconstruction of Islamic education methodologies through the integration of hybrid learning models and deep learning approaches to create a humanistic, reflective, and technology-based learning experience. The study employs a qualitative approach using library research by reviewing various journals, books, and scientific articles relevant to digital transformation, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and Islamic education in the Society 5.0 era. The results indicate that the reconstruction of Islamic Education methodology requires shifting the learning paradigm from surface learning toward deep learning, which emphasizes deep understanding, spiritual reflection, and the application of Islamic values in real life. title: PENGARUH MODEL PEMBELAJARAN PROBLEM BASED LEARNING (PBL) BERBANTUAN ALAT PERAGA SEDERHANA TERHADAP HASIL BELAJAR IPA PADA SISWA KELAS IV SD NEGERI 01 SAWAHAN KOTA PADANG
abstract: This research was motivated by students’ lack of problem-solving skills, low student participation in the learning process, and the limited use of teaching aids, which contributed to the low science learning outcomes of fourth-grade students at SD Negeri 01 Sawahan, Padang City. The low learning outcomes were also influenced by the lack of variation in learning models and the limited use of instructional media during the learning process. This study aimed to determine the effect of the Problem Based Learning (PBL) model assisted by simple teaching aids on the science learning outcomes of fourth-grade students at SD Negeri 01 Sawahan, Padang City. This study employed a quantitative approach using a quasi-experimental method with a Posttest Only Control Design. Class IV A was selected as the experimental class, while class IV B was the control class. Data were collected using a learning outcomes test and analyzed through normality testing, homogeneity testing, and hypothesis testing using the t-test. title: IMPLEMENTASI PENDEKATAN SCIENTIFIC DALAM MENINGKATKAN KEMAMPUAN LITERASI SAINS PESERTA DIDIK SEKOLAH DASAR PADA PEMBELAJARAN IPAS: A SYSTEMATIC LITERATURE REVIEW
abstract: Scientific literacy is one of the essential twenty-first-century competencies that enables students to understand scientific phenomena, make evidence-based decisions, and solve problems encountered in everyday life. Within the implementation of the Merdeka Curriculum, Integrated Science and Social Studies (IPAS) learning is designed to foster scientific thinking through the scientific approach, which consists of observing, questioning, experimenting, reasoning, and communicating. This study aims to analyze the implementation of the scientific approach in IPAS learning as an effort to strengthen elementary school students' scientific literacy based on findings reported in previous studies. The study employed a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) following the PRISMA 2020 guidelines. Relevant articles published between 2021 and 2026 were retrieved from Google Scholar, Scopus, ERIC, and Garuda databases and selected using predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria. The selected studies were analyzed thematically to identify patterns and research trends. title: KAJIAN FEMINISME DALAM NOVEL “PEREMPUAN YANG MENUNGGU DI LORONG MENUJU LAUT” KARYA DIAN PURNOMO DAN RELEVANSINYA TERHADAP PENDIDIKAN KESETARAAN GENDER DALAM PEMBELAJARAN SASTRA
abstract: This study aims to describe the forms of gender inequality, identify feminist values ​​in the novel "Women Waiting in the Corridor to the Sea" by Dian Purnomo, and explain its relevance to gender equality education in literature learning at a private vocational school in Jambi, Medan. The study uses a qualitative descriptive method with a feminist literary criticism approach. The research data source is the novel "Women Waiting in the Corridor to the Sea" by Dian Purnomo, while the data are in the form of quotations that show forms of gender inequality and feminist values. Data collection techniques are carried out through documentation, reading, note-taking, and supported by student questionnaires as supplementary data. Data analysis uses the Miles, Huberman, and Saldaña model which includes data reduction, data presentation, and drawing conclusions. The results of the study show that the novel represents five forms of gender inequality, namely marginalization, subordination, stereotypes, violence against women, and double burdens. title: IMPLEMENTASI KURIKULUM MERDEKA MELALUI PEMBELAJARAN BERDIFERENSIASI DALAM MENINGKATKAN KUALITAS PEMBELAJARAN DI SEKOLAH DASAR: A SYSTEMATIC LITERATURE REVIEW
abstract: The Merdeka Curriculum positions differentiated instruction as an important strategy for student-centered learning that responds to differences in readiness, interests, and learning profiles. Its implementation in elementary schools, however, still faces challenges related to teacher competence, instructional planning, diagnostic assessment, and supporting facilities. This study analyzes the implementation of differentiated instruction within the Merdeka Curriculum in elementary schools by synthesizing published research. A Systematic Literature Review (SLR) was conducted following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020 guidelines. Literature published from 2021 to 2026 was retrieved from Scopus, ERIC, Google Scholar, Garuda, and Crossref, selected using inclusion and exclusion criteria, and analyzed thematically. The review indicates that differentiated instruction improves student engagement, motivation, learning outcomes, critical thinking, creativity, collaboration, and problem-solving through adaptations in content, process, product, and learning environment. title: MANAJEMEN PENDIDIKAN BERBASIS KEPEMIMPINAN INSTRUKSIONAL, KOLABORASI, DAN PERBAIKAN SEKOLAH DI SEKOLAH DASAR
abstract: Educational management in primary schools increasingly requires principals to integrate instructional leadership, organizational management, teacher collaboration, evidence-informed decision making, equity, and staff well-being. This systematic literature review synthesizes recent international evidence on management practices that contribute to school quality at the primary education level. The review followed PRISMA 2020 reporting principles and focused on peer-reviewed reviews, meta-analyses, major research syntheses, and empirical studies published mainly between 2021 and 2026. Sources were identified through scholarly databases and publisher platforms using combinations of school leadership, educational management, primary school, instructional leadership, distributed leadership, school improvement, teacher collaboration, and well-being. title: SYSTEMATIC LITERATURE REVIEW : COLLABORATIVE GOVERNANCE PADA LAYANAN KEIMIGRASIAN DI INDONESIA
abstract: The provision of immigration services in Indonesia involves various actors and forms of collaboration, including passport services, foreigner supervision, and migrant worker protection. This study aims to identify forms of Collaborative Governance in immigration services in Indonesia and analyze its supporting and inhibiting factors based on the perspective of Ansell and Gash. This study employs a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) using the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) stages. Literature searches through Google Scholar initially identified 50 articles, which were screened based on inclusion and exclusion criteria, resulting in seven articles for analysis. Thematic analysis was conducted using four dimensions of Collaborative Governance: starting conditions, institutional design, facilitative leadership, and collaborative process. The findings show that collaboration occurs in passport services, foreigner supervision, and migrant worker protection. Supporting factors include communication, trust, commitment, role distribution, and leadership, while barriers include limited resources, sectoral ego, data integration, and coordination.

title: PERANCANGAN MOBILE APP E-RAIHAN DI BALEE PENDIDIKAN AL-QUR'AN MENGGUNAKAN FRAMEWORK FLUTTER
abstract: Balee Pendidikan Al-Qur'an Ar-Raihan still manages its administration conventionally through control cards carried by the students, so that attendance records, recitation progress, and tuition information are difficult for parents to monitor and prone to physical loss. This study aims to design and build the E-Raihan mobile application based on the Flutter framework to support digital administrative management, covering digital attendance, automatic attendance recapitulation, recording of recitation and memorisation progress, and automatic tuition notification to guardians. The research uses Research and Development with a descriptive quantitative approach and the Waterfall development model. Requirement data were collected through a Likert scale questionnaire distributed to 82 respondents, namely 42 teachers and 40 guardians, and produced a grand mean of 3.94 in the high category, so that the digitalisation of the administrative system was proven to be genuinely needed.
